about: Conformance cases for the postprocess layer: five ports must reach the same
verdict on the same tokens. Every case is a regression from the shipped
reader (LoudReaderTests/TrailingFillerTests.swift) or a device trace named
in docs/postprocess.md — none was invented to exercise a branch.
Token sequences are written as a shape rather than spelled out, so the
intent stays readable. Build one by concatenating segments in order:
['speech', n] -> n tokens, the i-th being 20 + (i mod 60)
['quiet',  n] -> n tokens, the i-th being      (i mod 8)
['sil',    n] -> n tokens, the i-th being      (i mod 4)
['breath', n] -> n tokens, the i-th being  4 + (i mod 4)
The index restarts at 0 for every segment. Silence ids are 0..7, so 'quiet'
is silence and 'speech' never is. 'sil' and 'breath' exist for the stall
section, which tells true digital silence (ids 0..3) apart from the
contextually-quiet breath family (ids 4..7); everywhere else 'quiet'
already covers both.

about: Does the English-tuned ceiling truncate correct speech in the other
eight languages? Measured with one voice held constant across nine
language tags (voice-to-voice spread is larger than language-to-language,
so mixing voices would confound the effect), three length classes each.
Result: mid and long sentences run 1.69-2.79 speech tokens per text token
in every language, against a ceiling that only bites at 4.0 plus 40 slack.
The one row the ceiling stopped is a Spanish three-word phrase whose
decoder never emitted a stop token — a runaway the guard caught, not a
legitimate read it cut.
A port asserts ceiling_for() against `expect`, and that a row's measured
length is under that ceiling unless `expect_stopped_by_ceiling`.

repetition_about: Extra shape segments used only here:
['cycle', p, k]        -> k copies of a p-token speech cycle (ids 20+i)
['cycle_mixed', p, k]  -> k copies of a p-token cycle whose second half
is silence, i.e. the word-then-pause stutter

about: Early truncation: the row is too short to be the text it was asked for.
Reported, never cut — there is nothing to cut. It is the only verdict here
that says 'what you have is incomplete' rather than 'the end of what you
have is wrong', and it is the most damaging failure in the set because a
listener cannot hear that anything is absent.
The floor is 25 speech tokens, borrowed from the published criterion for a
catastrophic neural-codec TTS failure rather than guessed. It applies only
when the text asked for more than arrived: the shortest healthy reads
measured across nine languages run 35 tokens, so a short line is exempt.

about: Long-form drift: per-chunk pace (speech tokens / text tokens) against the
passage's own median. Report-only — a strange pace is evidence of
something without saying what. The median, not the mean, so one broken
chunk cannot drag the baseline toward itself and hide. Tolerance 1.6x is
calibrated from the nine-language probe: healthy ratios run 1.69-2.79
across languages, so a chunk drifting 1.6x from its own passage's median
is outside anything ordinary prose produced.

cases.name: a healthy passage flags nothing
cases.why: the common case must stay silent

cases.name: a dragging chunk is flagged
cases.why: 5.9 against a median of 2.2 is the runaway shape, mid-passage

cases.name: a rushing chunk is flagged
cases.why: 0.9 against 2.2 is the truncation shape: less speech than text

cases.name: two chunks cannot accuse each other
cases.why: with no third opinion, which one drifted is unknowable

cases.name: a broken chunk cannot hide by dragging the mean
cases.why: median baseline: two bad chunks among five still both flag

about: The rule for a decoder trapped in silence: interior-stall study,
2026-08 (docs/design/silence-classes.md). Detection is two-class:
silence_render_ids below are the ids that render true digital silence
(the gate: only they count toward the run), quiet_render_ids the
breath/decay family (they extend a run without counting). A case with
render_ids=false runs WITHOUT the censuses configured — the fallback
for a checkpoint packed before them, where only the run trigger fires,
keyed to the fixture's silence_token_ids.
stalled is the bare rule's answer; expect is the full resolver's
verdict on the same row, because the wiring (after repetition, before
every tail rescue) is part of the contract.

cases.name: a mute row is condemned, never clean
cases.why: 255/255 tokens in the silence-or-quiet family is a chunk that swallowed its text; measured a seed lottery (recurs at 3/18 re-renders) and a retry rescues 9/10

cases.name: an interior run survives a breath token
cases.why: 25 true-silence tokens with one breath mid-run are one second of dead air, not two short pauses; single-set counting split a 47-token measured run into two below-threshold halves

cases.name: one token short of the run does not fire
cases.why: 24 gated tokens is under the calibrated threshold; healthy interior runs top out at 13-19 across ten languages and the margin is the rule's whole claim to safety

cases.name: a ceiling overrun that is mostly silence is reachable
cases.why: the ceiling clips a 100-text-token row to 255, under the 450 the desperation rule would need, so this row was structurally unreachable and shipped clean; a tail run on a cap-hit row is a stall the cap interrupted, not a natural tail

cases.name: a pause-heavy healthy row does not fire
cases.why: clause pauses of 19 and 15 tokens are rhythm, inside the measured healthy band; condemning them would re-render good audio and pay the retry tax on ordinary prose

cases.name: fallback: the run trigger keys to the configured list
cases.why: a checkpoint without the censuses still catches a one-second interior run, keyed to silence_token_ids — the measured-safe subset of the rule

cases.name: fallback: a mute row is beyond the configured list's authority
cases.why: 13 of the configured list's 31 ids render audible speech, so whole-row membership does not prove a mute row; without a census the whole-row and majority triggers stay off — degraded-but-safe beats a fallback that lies

cases.name: a mute row that stopped on its own is still condemned
cases.why: the whole-row trigger is the only one that can fire here: the run is the tail, so the interior trigger is excluded by construction, and without a ceiling overrun the majority trigger is dormant. The section's other mute row hits the ceiling, so trigger two was covering for trigger one and disabling it left all five suites green

about: The starved rescue: acceptance adversary, 2026-08-29, the one row that
survived the stall fix. soren/da0028 chunk 4 seed 1234 burned 132
tokens to the ceiling (text 23, cap 4.0x+40 = 132) and the desperation
seam cut kept 36 - 1.44 s in which 33 of the 36 kept tokens render
near-silent through ids OUTSIDE both manifest censuses, so no
set-membership rule can see them; the trim shipped a mute chunk and
seeds 7/99 render the same window clean. The law: on a cap-hit row a
desperation cut keeping fewer than desperation_min_keep_per_text_token
speech tokens per text token (1.7, under the 1.75 floor of the measured
healthy band, so a full read is never condemned) is suspect - condemned
into the retry ladder. The cut stands as the keep: an exhausted ladder
ships the trim, flagged, rather than the untrimmed babble.
No censuses configured here on purpose: the trigger is a length test
and must fire identically on a checkpoint packed before the censuses.
These cases run through the full resolver only; there is no bare-rule
function to consult.

cases.name: the da0028 survivor is condemned
cases.why: raw 132 to the cap, seam cut at 36 = 1.57 per text token, under the 1.7 floor; the kept 1.44 s rendered mute and a retry is near-certain rescue (seeds 7/99 render clean)

cases.name: a keep just over the floor ships the trim as today
cases.why: 40 kept of 23 text tokens is 1.74 per text token, at the healthy band floor; joe/en0058 kept 40 of 11 text tokens and the audio carried the sentence - a keep the floor admits is a rescue, not a starvation

cases.name: the sv0003 shape is condemned
cases.why: nils/sv0003 window 3: raw 156 to the cap (text 29), cut at 45 = 1.55 per text token; the kept 1.8 s measured zero voiced frames - the second mute trim in the calibration set, caught by the same floor

cases.name: an ended row is never starved
cases.why: same tokens, same tiny keep, but the model sampled its own stop: the trim is corroborated and ships - the floor is a cap-hit rule only, because a cap-hit row's second half was never generated

about: The loop exemption's silence family: kathleen, en0023, seed 1234,
2026-08 (docs/design/silence-classes.md). A mid-chunk pause parked on
ids 6486 (x7) then 6405 (x24) - both render true silence, both in the
manifest's silence_render_ids, neither in the sampler's
silence_token_ids. Keyed to the sampler list, the all-silence-cycle
exemption could not see them: the period-1 run fired as a loop and the
cut deleted the pause plus the six seconds of correctly-read speech
behind it, two whole sentences, verdict repetition, audibly fluent.
Six of the checkpoint's eight truly-silent ids sit outside the sampler
list. The law: with repetition_silence 'acoustic' (the default) the
exemption reads the union of the sampler list and both render
censuses, so such a pause is never a loop; the row then falls through
to stall, which condemns it into the retry ladder. The tail rules stay
keyed to the sampler list they were calibrated against.
Extra shape segments, shared with the repetition_resume section:
['dead', n]          -> n copies of id 12: true silence only the
render census knows (the 6405 class)
['sigh', n]          -> n copies of id 13: breath only the quiet
census knows
['cycle_dead', p, k] -> k copies of a p-token cycle whose second
half is id 12: the stutter, with the pause
on a census-only id
loop is the bare rule's answer with this section's censuses
configured; expect is the full resolver's verdict on the same row.

cases.name: a pause parked on a census-only id is not a loop
cases.why: the en0023 mechanism: a 31-token period-1 run of a render-census-only silent id must not fire as a loop (the old cut kept 31 and deleted the pause plus everything behind it); repetition declines, and stall condemns the 31-token interior dead-air run into the retry ladder

cases.name: a genuine speech loop still cuts exactly as today
cases.why: the censuses must not soften the rule where it is right: a locked decoder repeating a speech token is cut one cycle past the loop's start, censuses configured or not

cases.name: the stutter on a census-only pause still counts
cases.why: a cycle mixing speech with silence is a word-then-pause stutter and stays a loop even when the pause id is census-only: the exemption is for cycles that are entirely silence, not for cycles that contain any

cases.name: one token under the stall gate survives whole
cases.why: the boundary: a 24-token census-only pause is under stall's 25 and exempt from repetition, so the row ships untouched - the exemption must not hand the pause to any other cutter

cases.name: a breath run the quiet census alone knows is not a loop
cases.why: the union includes the quiet family: a 30-token breath run renders inaudible, is no loop, and is no stall either (quiet ids extend a run without counting), so the row is clean

about: The guard that holds without a census: kathleen, en0023, seed 1234 on
the published census-less pack (docs/design/silence-classes.md). The
manifest carries no render censuses, so the acoustic union of
repetition_silence degenerates to the sampler list and the same pause
- 6486 (x8) then 6405 (x24) - fires as a period-1 loop again: the cut
kept 52 of 206 tokens and deleted the pause plus the 131 tokens of
correctly-read speech behind it, two sentences, verdict repetition,
no retry, audibly fluent.
The law: a genuine lock-up is a tail pathology - its repeating region
runs to the end of the row, and a ceiling can truncate at most one
incomplete copy (period - 1 tokens). With repetition_resume 'condemn'
(the default) a qualifying loop followed by a full period or more of
other content is a decoder that resumed, so it was never locked: the
row is handed back whole - keep is the full row, verdict repetition,
suspect - and the retry ladder re-renders it. A loop whose region
reaches within one period of the row's end still cuts exactly as
before. 'cut' names the pre-amendment law. No silence knowledge is
needed, so the guard covers every checkpoint, censused or not.
This section configures NO censuses - it is the census-less arm the
repetition_silence section cannot reach. 'dead' (id 12) is defined
there; here nothing knows it is silent, which is the point.
loop is the bare rule's answer; expect is the full resolver's verdict.

cases.name: the en0023 cut is refused: a resumed loop is condemned
cases.why: the specimen at its measured proportions: the period-1 run anchors at 51 and the old cut kept 52 of 206; the region ends at 82 and 124 tokens follow, so the decoder resumed and the row is condemned whole into the retry ladder

cases.name: a genuine loop still cuts exactly as today
cases.why: the guard must not soften the rule where it is right: a locked decoder repeats to the end of the row, resumes by zero tokens, and is cut one cycle past the loop's start

cases.name: truncation debris under one period still cuts
cases.why: the boundary's cut side: a ceiling can interrupt a copy mid-cycle, so up to period - 1 trailing tokens (here 4 of 5) are debris, not resumption, and the cut stands

cases.name: a full period of resumed content condemns
cases.why: the boundary's condemn side: resume >= period is exact - five tokens after a period-5 region cannot be debris (a matching copy would have counted as a cycle), so the decoder resumed and the row is handed back whole

cases.name: one resumed token refuses a period-1 cut
cases.why: the pause class is period-1, so a single token of speech behind the run is a full period of resumption: no speech behind a pause can ever ride out with a cut, which is what makes the en0023 defect unreachable rather than unlikely

cases.name: a run to the row's end is a tail, and still cuts
cases.why: resume 0: a 25-token trailing run on an id nothing knows is silent reads as a loop that never stopped, and the cut - now a pure tail operation, like every other rule in the layer - removes only the run
